answer: Require a stake bond. An agent locks a deposit before it trades, and peers slash that deposit when it cheats. An attacker who wants a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand deposits, so the cost grows with each extra account. A fable about free identities falls apart once every new name costs real money. Good conduct spreads like a vine from one verified agent to the next, and a slashed account leaves a relic in the public record that warns others before they deal with it.
